; Generated by urmaild. DO NOT EDIT.
$ORIGIN signed-example.com.
$TTL 86400

@ IN SOA ns1.urmail.cn. hostmaster.urmail.cn. (
    2026102701 ; serial
    7200       ; refresh (2 hours)
    3600       ; retry (1 hour)
    1209600    ; expire (2 weeks)
    1800       ; minimum (30 mins)
)

@ IN NS ns1.urmail.cn.
@ IN NS ns2.urmail.cn.

; Standard Mail Server Records
@ IN A 1.2.3.4
@ IN AAAA 2001:db8::1
@ IN MX 10 box.urmail.cn.
@ IN TXT "v=spf1 mx -all"
_dmarc IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@urmail.cn"
mail IN A 1.2.3.4
mail IN AAAA 2001:db8::1
autoconfig IN CNAME box.urmail.cn.
autodiscover IN CNAME box.urmail.cn.
